data.action: 坐在喷泉边沿短暂小憩，墨镜挂在衣领
data.description: 【希露菲 · 学院庭院喷泉】夏亚魔法大学开满鲜花的中庭喷泉旁，希露菲将墨镜挂在白衬衫衣领上，坐在大理石喷泉沿上享受着片刻的宁静。微风拂过她柔顺的白发，她转头对你露出治愈的微笑——「偶尔像这样什么也不思考地晒晒太阳，感觉心底所有的不安都被洗净了呢。」
data.location: 夏亚魔法大学庭院喷泉
data.promptProse: Sylphiette rests on the marble fountain rim in her white Fitz academy uniform and cape, sunglasses hanging from the collar rather than hiding her eyes. The medium portrait includes fountain water beside her and green campus lawns beyond the seated pause. Clear sunlight brightens short white hair and the marble edge, with rippling water reflections flickering across the uniform sleeve and soft shade under the fountain's curved rim.
